name: Algebraic Boolean Encoding
description: Replaced the explicit logical phrasing "fault if both are opposite" with an algebraic inequality over {-1, 1} variables. The condition V(x)*sgn(x) + V(y)*sgn(y) >= 0 is mathematically identical to the 2-SAT clause (x == sgn(x) OR y == sgn(y)), but forces the model to algebraically evaluate the domain of the terms to discover the 2-SAT structure, breaking direct text-to-clause pattern matching.
